justifications.type_expressiveness: Good enum modeling for Expr/BinOp/UnOp/Value/EvalError, but ParseError and EvalError::TypeError carry free-form String messages and overflow is conflated with type errors instead of having its own variant.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with the required three EvalError variants and proper offset on ParseError; uses checked arithmetic and Result throughout, though unreachable!() and overflow-as-TypeError are minor blemishes.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public types have basic derives and Display, but no doc comments on any public item, and ParseError exposes raw String/usize fields rather than accessor methods.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, matches!, and derives consistently, but the lookup loop could be an iterator chain, the let-binding extraction uses an awkward if-let-else-unreachable pattern, and several String clones could be avoided.
